full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 59
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Wednesday, Ashoj 7, 2083
11:00 AM (Tentative)
1. Letter from the Office of the President
The Honorable Speaker will read out the contents of the letter received from the Office of the President regarding the Prime Minister's portfolio.
2. Management Work
Honorable Minister for Physical Infrastructure Development, Sunil Lamsal:
a) Will present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Solid Waste Management Bill, 2083".
b) Will introduce the "Solid Waste Management Bill, 2083".
3. Honorable Minister for Finance, Dr. Swarnim Wagle:
a) Will present a proposal for consideration of the "Citizen Investment Fund (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083".
b) Will present a proposal for consideration of the "Payment and Settlement (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
4. Honorable Minister for Agriculture, Forests and Environment, Gita Chaudhary will present a proposal for consideration of the "Infectious Animal Disease (Control) Bill, 2083" which originated in the National Assembly.
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The Minister for Physical Infrastructure Development will seek permission to introduce and then introduce the Solid Waste Management Bill, 2083. The Minister for Finance will present proposals for consideration of the Citizen Investment Fund (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083 and the Payment and Settlement (First Amendment) Bill, 2083. The Minister for Agriculture, Forests and Environment will present a proposal for consideration of the Infectious Animal Disease (Control) Bill, 2083.
